C. A. 7th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 423 U. S. 1030.] Motions of League of Women Voters of the United States et al. and American Society of Planning Officials for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted.

Mr. Justice Stevens took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions.
